clinical_result: Initial trial focused on safety; termination was replacement by a more potent candidate, not a demonstrated pivotal efficacy failure.
development_status: Ionis developer-authored account explicitly says development was terminated in favor of an improved molecule; tofersen is distinct.
evidence_basis: First-party historical account by Ionis drug developers, published in a review; not an unrelated secondary inference.

clinical_result: Investigators report no clinical effect despite persistent CSF ARSA restoration, including in presymptomatic patients.
development_status: Negative clinical evidence established; no definitive current continuation or formal program-wide termination recovered.
uncertainty: Formal disposition and stop date remain unresolved. New vectors for MLD are not evidence this original product continues.
evidence_basis: Original research paper from investigators explicitly describing their prior clinical trial experience.

clinical_result: Early signal of slower progression; distribution limitations prompted consideration of a different delivery route and additional preclinical work.
development_status: Lexeo sought partners in2024; its September2026 quarter10Q states license terminated and CLN2 IND returned to Cornell inOctober2026.
uncertainty: Cornell continuation/relicensing not established. Sponsor exit is not proof of permanent molecule failure.
evidence_basis: Sponsor community letter and latest SEC filing.

clinical_result: GENERATION HD2 met safety/biomarker objectives but showed no meaningful clinical efficacy benefit against placebo.
development_status: Roche explicitly discontinued clinical development July9,2026. This is the later HD2 decision, not simply the2021HD1 trial halt.
uncertainty: No current continuation established; exact disclosed stop date known.

clinical_result: Early study met its safety objective; successor engineering changed the promoter and removed SUMF1 to improve the construct.
development_status: Development shifted to distinct LYS-SAF302. No standalone ongoing SAF301 development recovered.
uncertainty: Exact formal SAF301 retirement date not established; this is not a verified pivotal clinical failure.
evidence_basis: Issuer annual registration document and developer presentation.

clinical_result: Five-and-a-half-year followup found no confirmed cognitive benefit in three older children; youngest child had a more favorable course in an uncontrolled four-patient study.
development_status: uniQure explicitly deprioritized program November14,2016 and discussed discontinuation or transfer. Later patient followup publication does not establish renewed drug development.
uncertainty: Final transfer/termination and any current active successor not established.
evidence_basis: Sponsor filing and original long-term clinical report.
